The '''Seventh Pius Dea Crusade''', more commonly known as the '''Great Northern Crusade''', was a military campaign orchestrated by the [[Pius Dea]] religious cult during the [[Pius Dea Era]]. In [[11,884 BBY]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;under the control of the Pius Dea and led by the [[Contispex dynasty]] of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]]&mdash;launched a military campaign against the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] and [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Pius Dea Crusades|Crusade]] consisted of attacks against the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of [[Alien/Legends|alien]] species, all of which were located in the northern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The Republic launched forces from [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] against the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], homeworld of the Ithorians, and used [[Ord Cantrell/Legends|Ord Cantrell]] and [[Meglumine|Ord Meglumine]] as a staging points against the Zabrak homeworld of [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Great Northern Crusade first appeared in the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', in a map depicting the Crusades. Named the "Great Northern Crusade" on the map and legend, it also states that the Crusade was the 7th in parentheses.<ref name="EGW" />
